title: Awesome Aromatic Turkish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Turkish lamb stew featuring fatty and juicy lamb, served with crusty rye bread, perfect for a sick day, and made in a bain-marie for gentle heat, this dish is also Jain-friendly as it contains no animal by-products or root vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the stew in the oven for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
While the stew is cooking, prepare the bain-marie by filling a large bowl with hot water.
Place the cubed rye bread in a separate bowl and place it in the bain-marie to warm.
Serve the stew hot, with the warmed rye bread on the side.
